name: llvm-project
description_en: The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
readme_excerpt: The LLVM Compiler Infrastructure Welcome to the LLVM project! This repository contains the source code for LLVM, a toolkit for the construction of highly optimized compilers, optimizers, and run-time environments. The LLVM project has multiple components. The core of the project is itself called "LLVM". This contains all of the tools, libraries, and header files needed to process intermediate representations and convert them into object files.
